notes: v283 — MANIFEST-PEG-PLACES (Oct 29, 2026, owner feedback 14:26 MDT). The owner: make sure these peg pickups and peg dumps go on the manifest — as where it is being loaded and where it is being dumped. v282 marked peg days in the data only; the manifest now SHOWS them. BUILD: (1) modules/manifest.js — collect() resolves the day pegged places via pegPlaceLabels: each role peg sequence (the pegLog in order, the day final pegs appended) resolves through the manifest own placeNameFor (saved places, built-in pits, learned-pair labels), so places print BY NAME, never coordinates; a peg at a place the app has never seen prints its peg time (Pegged pickup — 2:14 PM). Every DISTINCT place per role, in the order pegged (a place is itself again by name; an unnamed place is itself again within the peg counter own 30 m). docLines prints Loaded at / Dumped at lines in the Day summary (no section toggle — the pegs are the driver own declared facts, v191 standing) and dayBodyHtml prints the screen twins; a role never pegged prints no line, and days without pegs render byte-for-byte as before. (2) js/geoloads.js — setPeg now logs each peg move with its position ({kind, t, lat, lng}) so a mid-day re-peg place can be named; pre-v283 log entries (kind + t only) resolve from the day final pegs — no place invented for a move whose spot was never recorded.
